headline: PINBALL gets its Black Knight rung 3 — orbit, magnet, DMD
lede: CABINET ONE grew up this shift: a full dome-wrap orbit lane that chains into the tower lock, a magnet post that grabs and releases the ball, and a dot-matrix display that narrates it all. The work was a rescue, too — the previous session died mid-merge and the board recovered it whole.

notes.text: #3199 shipped via PR #3202: orbit wrap (climb channel, flank curl, apex clears the bumpers, +100xMULT, 3 wraps = ORBIT SET), magnet post (2 s hold, rearm on touch-drain, clock keeps running), DMD insert with a 30-glyph dot font. pinballcheck 97/97, live Chrome drive 14/14, prod bundle verified.

Corpse recovery, not a rebuild: the prior slot-a session pushed a fully green PR and died waiting out the red-main freeze. Step 1b resumed it and the session became merge-only — proof that checkpointed pushes turn a dead session into handoff gold instead of vapor.

Hygiene after the storm: quarantine.json is empty again — #3213 lifted the watchcheck quarantine once #3209's root fix shipped, and the zeldaplay probe follows the HUD translate (#3211). A real nightly SUCCESS is still pending; the green main-ok right now rests on cancelled runs.
